name: monowatch
author: riverxorange
description: Local, read-only usage dashboard for Google Antigravity. Shows equivalent API cost and subscription value, per-model cache hit rate, TTFT and speed, context usage and compactions, and subagent costs, in light/dark and English/Chinese.
suggestedPrompts: Open monowatch to see my usage this billing cycle
How much context is this conversation using?
Which model has been the fastest for me recently?
